page.overview:
Who is Popcorn Seller?

The Popcorn Seller is a minor character in A Bug's Life. He is the bug vendor of P.T. Flea's Circus.

""Popcorn, stale popcorn!" a bug vendor yells as he carries a hefty kernel past the flies in the stands. But business isn't exactly popping. The audience is too busy booing the show to want food—unless it's to throw at the performers."
